blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon has clarified that while their proposed changes to their 2027 national budget would be geared toward flood control projects, other infrastructure items would also benefit from the amendments. Dizon clarified on Thursday, during an ambush interview at the Batasang Pambansa complex, that among the flood control projects that will form part of the P20 billion proposed amendments will include drainage improvements and detention basins. The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) head said that a consideration for the changes was borne out of an assessment on which projects should have priority, especially […]...
